verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a processor (APU). Asking whether its API matches its UI is a SaaS-style question that does not fit a chip with no product UI. The pack documents developer APIs for the Ryzen AI software stack (ONNX Runtime C++/Python, the Lemonade server interface), but nothing shows a UI whose features an API would need to mirror, so the parity axis never becomes applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
